name: io.github.m-colley.embodied-ui
description: Lockstep bridge between MuJoCo bodies (embodied-ui, MyoSuite) and Unity. Simulated fingers, hands and feet operate Unity input devices, touchscreens and UI; Unity returns poses, lamps, sounds, vibrations, displays and camera images.

samples.description: A WheelCollider car driven by vehicle.throttle, vehicle.brake and vehicle.steer.
